---
name: clubadmin-task
description: club admin
---

<!-- Tip: Use /create-prompt in chat to generate content with agent assistance -->

- club admin can do following:
  - Manage squads and add participants not coaches in the squads
  - manage club sessions and assign coaches to the sessions
  - club coach invitations does not need age group
  - club admin can choose the following levels
  - Level
  - Support Coach	Formerly Coach Support Worker	Supports qualified coaches; cannot coach independently	16+
  - Foundation Coach	1st4sport Level 1	Can assist or lead selected sessions under supervision	17+ (certification at 18)
  - Core Coach	1st4sport Level 2	Can coach independently and lead player-centred sessions	17+
  - Advanced Coach	1st4sport Level 3 (Performance / Head Coach)	Focuses on individuals, units, and teams in recreational or performance environments	Varies by application
  - Specialist Coach	1st4sport Level 4 (Master Coach Award)	Elite development and high-performance specialisation	Varies / Application-based
